question: What changes when the same broad instrument — military participation in civilian/religious activity — operates in the north-east and at a Buddhist restoration in Mihintale?
mechanism: Military labour, assets and organizations can be inserted into civilian functions across regions; reception and coercive meaning depend on local land, war-memory and commissioning conditions.
transmission_channel: state military institutions entering civilian economic or religious-production functions
time_lag: post-2009 north/east activity compared with a documented 2024 Mihintale restoration contribution
confounders: presence or absence of land dispossession
voluntary contribution versus occupation of assets/land
bounded_by: The comparison supports military civilian engagement as a broader mode of state practice rather than a northern exception. It does not show equivalent reception, coercion, legitimacy or outcomes in the two settings.
